name: DeepSeek
notes: In thinking mode with tools, reasoning_content of every earlier assistant turn must be sent back or the API returns 400. Prices are the peak rates (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC on weekdays); off-peak is half price. Caching is automatic and no cache write price is published, so cache write is set to the input price. Release dates come from models.dev (https://models.dev/).

upstreamModels.notes: Off-peak: input 0.15, cache read 0.003, output 0.6. maxOutputTokens is the published maximum. Cache write is not published; caching is automatic and a first pass is billed as input, so it is set to the input price.

Off-peak: input 0.66, cache read 0.022, output 1.98. Vision not supported. maxOutputTokens is the published maximum. Cache write is not published; caching is automatic and a first pass is billed as input, so it is set to the input price.
